title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Claims the Hodge conjecture for every abelian variety with complex multiplication, i.e. that every rational Hodge class on these varieties is built from algebraic subvarieties. Through results of Milne, that would also give the Tate conjecture for all abelian varieties over finite fields. The family also contains Kuga–Satake and Weil-class algebraicity papers.
constructive: no: cycles come from theta lifts on ball quotients plus p-adic Hodge arguments; nothing is computable
opportunity: None. CRYPTO was checked and rejected. Isogeny cryptography (SQIsign, CSIDH, 2D isogeny/Kani methods), the CM method for genus-2 curves (Igusa class polynomials, CMH/AVIsogenies) and pairings use only endomorphisms and divisor-level facts. Those are Tate's 1966 theorem and Honda–Tate, which were already known. Higher-codimension Tate classes and the Hodge standard conjecture appear in no algorithm or security argument. CAS was also checked. The only touchpoint is that LMFDB abelian-variety-over-F_q pages could read their 'Tate class' dimensions as ranks of algebraic cycles mod numerical equivalence. That is not worth doing on a claim at this confidence level.
caveats: WITHDRAWAL FLAG: this family is in the same area as the Oct 7 2026 withdrawals, which were the split-abelian-eightfold Weil-class paper and two Kuga–Satake/K3 dependents. I found no direct citation of the withdrawn papers. The CM paper's only OAI citation is Milne-rationality (family 001), and the K3-quadratic-locus paper cites no OAI work. However: (a) the CM theorem effectively claims algebraicity of split Weil classes on CM abelian varieties via André's reduction, the same kind of object as the withdrawn eightfold claim; (b) the withdrawn K3 Kuga–Satake papers generalized the K3-quadratic-locus paper in this family; (c) 'Weil classes on abelian powers' and 'Abelian covers/Gale' rest on the CM theorem; (d) the claims are extraordinary (Tate conjecture for all abelian varieties over F_q, Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties) and nothing is formalized. Confidence is set to 1.
evidence: web: LMFDB av/fq + exceptional Tate classes literature (arXiv 2003.05380, 2505.09589)

title: Iitaka subadditivity, variation, and logarithmic additivity
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Iitaka's subadditivity of Kodaira dimension and logarithmic and orbifold variants: for a fibration, the 'amount of canonical positivity' of the total space is at least that of the fibre plus the base.
opportunity: None. This is a structural inequality in birational classification with no algorithmic or applied use.
caveats: Extraordinary claim (full Iitaka C_{n,m} conjecture). Lean covers only the negative-fibre branch of logarithmic additivity, not the top line. It is the root of the abundance/MMP chain in 034, 036, 056 and 066.

title: Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Claims log abundance in every dimension: on a log canonical pair, if K_X+Δ is nef then it is semiample. Also claims an effective Iitaka fibration (one uniform pluricanonical degree m(d) per dimension) and uniform indices for log Calabi–Yau pairs.
opportunity: None. CAS was checked. If m(d) were explicit, Kodaira dimension and Iitaka fibrations would become decidable by computing finitely many plurigenera in Macaulay2/Singular. But m(d) and the index bounds are pure existence results from boundedness/ACC arguments with no value given, so no algorithm follows.
caveats: Extraordinary claims (abundance conjecture). Six Kähler MMP/abundance manuscripts were repaired on Oct 7, including two in this family. Everything depends on the 033 Iitaka subadditivity. Constants are non-explicit.

title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the numerical-dimension-one case of log abundance for threefold pairs in characteristic p > 3.
opportunity: None. This is pure birational geometry in positive characteristic.
caveats: Unformalized.

title: Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Claims generalized abundance (a nef adjoint K+B+M is numerically semiample) and existence of minimal models or Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical pairs.
opportunity: None. Existence of minimal models gives no implementable procedure, and there is no general MMP software beyond toric/Mori-dream-space cases.
caveats: Depends on 034's characteristic-zero log abundance. The Kähler manuscript was repaired on Oct 7. Extraordinary claim.

title: The ordinary-double-point volume gap
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves that every singular klt singularity of dimension n has 'normalized volume' at most 2(n-1)^n. The maximum is achieved only by the ordinary double point (the cone z_0^2+...+z_n^2=0).
opportunity: Physics corollary, of curiosity value only. For Calabi–Yau cones with a Ricci-flat metric, normalized volume equals n^n·Vol(L)/Vol(S^{2n-1}) for the Sasaki–Einstein link L (Martelli–Sparks–Yau, Li–Liu–Xu). The new n=4 case therefore says every Sasaki–Einstein 7-manifold other than round S^7 has volume ≤ Vol(V_{5,2}) = (81/128)Vol(S^7). In AdS4/CFT3, F_{S^3} ∝ N^{3/2}Vol^{-1/2}, which gives a universal large-N free-energy gap F ≥ sqrt(128/81)·F_{S^7} ≈ 1.257·F_{S^7} for M2-brane SCFTs with non-maximally-supersymmetric Sasaki–Einstein duals. The n=3 (AdS5, conifold/T^{1,1}) case was already known (Liu–Xu 2019). Only hep-th theorists benefit; no computation changes.
first_step: Write a one-page note stating the SE7 volume gap and the F_{S^3} gap, and check it against the tabulated SE7 volumes (V_{5,2}, Q^{111}, M^{111}, N^{010}, toric families).
caveats: Unformalized, though it builds on established normalized-volume theory and the dimension-4 base case is a separate companion paper. The physics translation assumes the Ricci-flat cone exists (K-polystable), which holds for Sasaki–Einstein links by definition. Known volumes (Q^{111}=π^4/8, M^{111}=9π^4/128) are consistent with the bound V_{5,2}=27π^4/128.

title: Fujita’s freeness conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Fujita's freeness conjecture: on a smooth projective n-fold, K_X+mL is generated by global sections for every ample L and every m ≥ n+1.
explicit_constants: explicit (m ≥ n+1) but no computational consumer
opportunity: None. CAS was checked. Adjoint systems are used algorithmically only for surfaces, e.g. Schicho-style rational-surface parametrization in Magma, where Reider's theorem (1988) already gives the bound. Dimensions 3–5 were already known. CAS works with embedded varieties and computes global generation directly.
caveats: Extraordinary claim (long-standing conjecture), single manuscript, unformalized.

title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Nagata's conjecture: a plane curve of degree d through r ≥ 10 very general points with multiplicities m_i satisfies Σm_i < d·sqrt(r). Equivalently, the r-point Seshadri constant of P^2 is 1/sqrt(r). Also shows multipoint Seshadri constants are maximal for large r on any polarized variety.
constructive: no: degeneration argument at very general points; certifies no explicit configuration
explicit_constants: explicit (sqrt r) for Nagata; r_0(X,L) non-explicit for higher-dim Seshadri
opportunity: None after checking the three channels that were asked about. (1) Splines/interpolation: through inverse systems (Emsalem–Iarrobino, Geramita–Schenck), trivariate C^r spline dimension on a vertex star with s interior faces involves R/(ℓ_i^{r+1}), which is dual to fat points of multiplicity d−r in P^2. Nagata only says this vanishes for d ≥ r·sqrt(s)/(sqrt(s)−1). For practical smoothness (r ≤ 2) that is trivial, because s ≥ 10 generic powers already span R_{r+1}. In general, Nagata adds nothing for m ≤ 11, where SHGH was already verified (Dumnicki–Jarnicki). Spline and Hermite poisedness questions need SHGH non-speciality, not Nagata. Real meshes and grids are not 'very general': my mod-p check found nonzero systems throughout the Nagata range for points on a conic. (2) AG codes: Hansen's bound d ≥ n − L^2/e uses the Seshadri constant at the F_q-rational evaluation points. Those are maximally special, and the char-p result is only at the geometric generic (transcendental) tuple, so no code bound improves. (3) The Waldschmidt constant (Macaulay2 SymbolicPowers 'waldschmidt') equals sqrt(r) only for very general points and certifies nothing for a given rational point set.
caveats: Top line is Lean-formalized (OAI.Nagata.nagata_conjecture; the PlaneCurves dir has no sorry/axiom). The large-r Seshadri threshold r_0(X,L) is non-explicit (Lean doc). The 'very general' hypothesis means a countable union of exceptional loci, so no specific configuration is certified.
evidence: scratch: exact mod-p rank of fat-point systems at d=floor(m*sqrt r), random vs on-a-conic points (random: 0; conic: 6–91)
web: Little 'AG codes from higher-dimensional varieties' §3.3 (Hansen Seshadri bound at F_q-points); Dumnicki–Jarnicki math/0505183 (SHGH for m ≤ 11); Macaulay2 SymbolicPowers waldschmidt doc

title: Bloch’s conjecture for complex surfaces
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Bloch's conjecture: on a complex surface with no holomorphic 2-forms (p_g=0), the group of degree-zero 0-cycles is exactly the Albanese variety.
opportunity: None. This is about Chow groups of surfaces, with no computational or applied consumer.
caveats: Extraordinary claim, unformalized. No Hodge/Kuga–Satake dependence (grep checked).
evidence: grep of build/ for Kuga/Hodge-conjecture dependence

title: Hyperkähler SYZ and projective-space bases
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture (isotropic nef line bundles on compact hyperkähler manifolds give Lagrangian torus fibrations), and that the base of any such fibration is projective space.
opportunity: None. String compactification (PHYS) was checked. The result is structural: no string or mirror-symmetry computation (periods, GV invariants, Seiberg–Witten integrable systems, whose bases are non-compact) uses compact-HK base classification as an input.
caveats: Extraordinary claims (Matsushita base conjecture in full), unformalized.
evidence: grep of build/ for physics references (mentions only)

title: Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves every K3 surface (projective or not) is an Oka manifold, so maps into it satisfy a strong approximation principle. Also classifies which minimal surfaces of Kodaira dimension 0 and class VII are Oka.
opportunity: None. This is pure complex analysis.
caveats: Unformalized.

title: P = W for fixed-determinant SLn moduli spaces
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the P=W conjecture (perverse = weight filtrations) for fixed-determinant SL_n Higgs moduli in composite rank, completing the coprime case.
opportunity: None. This is nonabelian Hodge theory. Its mirror-symmetry content gives no computation.
caveats: Unformalized. The GL_n and prime-rank cases were already known.

title: The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the equivariant Hikita conjecture for arbitrary quivers: the equivariant cohomology of a Nakajima quiver variety equals the coordinate ring of a fixed-point scheme on the dual Coulomb branch (3d mirror symmetry).
opportunity: None. Physics (3d N=4 gauge theory) was checked: the result is a structural identity used only in representation theory and math-physics.
caveats: Unformalized.

title: Shafarevich counterexamples in dimension two and with large fundamental group
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Constructs projective varieties (a surface, and a fourfold with large fundamental group) whose universal covers are not holomorphically convex, disproving Shafarevich's conjecture.
constructive: partial: explicit construction of a variety, not a computational object
opportunity: None.
caveats: Surprising counterexample, unformalized.

title: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Gives an explicit 4-dimensional complex variety X that is not affine 4-space even though X × line is affine 5-space, disproving Zariski cancellation over C in dimension 4.
constructive: yes: explicit polynomial H and explicit automorphism
opportunity: None. CAS was checked. The explicit hypersurface H in 5 variables and the automorphism could serve as regression tests for Singular/Macaulay2 routines on locally nilpotent derivations and subalgebras. No user, and no solver that decides 'is this affine space', depends on it, and the multivariate-crypto 'tame automorphism' schemes work over F_q, where this is irrelevant.
caveats: Lean-formalized top line (OAI.ComplexCancellation.main, no sorry/axiom in dir).

title: A characteristic-zero counterexample to Lipman–Zariski
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Constructs a singular normal affine surface whose module of derivations is free, disproving the Lipman–Zariski conjecture in characteristic 0.
constructive: partial: existence via Artin approximation; no explicit equations
opportunity: None. CAS/resolution was checked: smoothness tests in CAS use the Jacobian criterion, not freeness of derivations.
caveats: The example comes from an analytic construction plus Artin algebraization, so no explicit equations are given. Unformalized.

title: A stable-coordinate counterexample in four variables
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Gives an explicit degree-5 polynomial in 4 variables that is not a coordinate but becomes one after adding a variable. Every fibre is affine 3-space, which disproves the stable-coordinate and Abhyankar–Sathaye conjectures in dimension 4.
constructive: yes: explicit degree-5 polynomial and stabilizing automorphism
opportunity: None. It is an explicit object, but no software or applied community needs to decide coordinate-hood; see 047. At most it is a regression instance for LND/invariant routines.
caveats: Lean-formalized (StableCoordinateFour, AbhyankarSathaye).

title: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Constructs explicit ample rank-2 vector bundles on P^1×P^1 that admit no Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric, disproving Griffiths' conjecture.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Lean-formalized.

title: Kobayashi’s canonical-ampleness conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves that a compact Kähler manifold with no entire holomorphic curves has ample canonical bundle (Kobayashi).
opportunity: None.
caveats: Extraordinary claim, unformalized.

title: Tangent splittings and product decompositions
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves that if the tangent bundle of a compact Kähler manifold splits into two integrable pieces, the universal cover splits as a product. On rationally connected manifolds integrability is automatic.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Lean-formalized.

title: A counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Constructs a tautological class on the moduli space of curves that is zero in Chow and cohomology but not implied by Pixton's relations, disproving Pixton's completeness conjecture. The example has genus 10^60.
constructive: yes in principle, but astronomically large
opportunity: None. The only software touchpoint is admcycles (Sage): generating_indices/toTautbasis compute a basis 'assuming the generalized Faber–Zagier relations give a complete set'. The counterexample is at g=10^60, far beyond any feasible computation (admcycles works at g ≲ 5), so no output changes. A docs caveat is at most cosmetic.
caveats: Galactic object (g = 10^60, n = 3·C(g,3)). Unformalized.

title: Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Shows that very general cubic fourfolds in Hassett divisors of large enough discriminant are irrational, even though they have associated K3 surfaces. This disproves Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture.
opportunity: None.
caveats: The discriminant threshold d_0 is ineffective. Unformalized. Extraordinary. No Kuga–Satake dependence found.

title: Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Constructs Bridgeland stability conditions with the exact 'physical' large-volume central charge Z = −∫e^{−B−itH}ch·sqrt(td) on every Calabi–Yau threefold, and a Gepner-point stability condition on every quintic threefold. It also proves a Bayer–Macrì–Toda-type tilt inequality ch3 ≤ (a²/6 + k)H²ch1 on every smooth projective threefold, with correction k = 0 beyond a volume threshold R_*.
constructive: partial: explicit hearts/charges, but thresholds come from existence arguments
explicit_constants: no: k, R_*, T depend on (X,H,B) through non-effective constants (C_0 from Frobenius presentation)
opportunity: The most credible string-theory channel in the batch, but weak. Rigorous GV/PT/rank-0 DT computations for compact CY3s (Feyzbakhsh–Thomas wall-crossing; Alexandrov–Feyzbakhsh–Klemm–Pioline–Schimannek Castelnuovo bounds and modular D4-D2-D0 predictions) depend on the BMT inequality. That inequality is proven only for X5 and X_{4,2} (weaker for X6, X8) and is open for the other hypergeometric models. This paper gives a corrected BMT inequality on every threefold, but the constants k and R_* come from a Frobenius-limit/spreading-out argument and are not computed. The large-volume tail does not reach the finite-volume walls those computations need. Making k explicit for the 13 hypergeometric one-parameter CY3 models is the research step; it would let topological-string groups extend rigorous boundary data.
targets: AFKPS / topological-string GV computations for one-parameter hypergeometric CY3s (X6, X8, X10, ...)
first_step: Trace C_0 in Lemma lem:frobenius-presentation and the apex constant A, C for X = sextic X6. Check whether an explicit k results and whether ch3 ≤ (a²/6+k)H²ch1 suffices for Feyzbakhsh's empty-chamber argument at the walls AFKPS use.
caveats: Constants k, R_* are non-explicit. Applies only at large volume unless k is made effective. The Gepner result adds symmetry to the existence result Li already proved, so nothing new is computable. Unformalized.
evidence: web: arXiv 2301.08066 (AFKPS; BMT status for hypergeometric CY3s)

title: Termination of projective and Kähler fourfold minimal model programs
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves that every sequence of flips terminates for log canonical fourfolds (projective, characteristic 0) and for generalized pairs on compact Kähler fourfolds, so minimal model programs in dimension 4 always stop.
opportunity: None. CAS was checked: no software runs general 4-fold MMPs (contractions and flips are not effectively computable). Toric/Mori-dream-space MMP implementations terminate trivially.
caveats: Three of five manuscripts were repaired on Oct 7. The projective result depends on 034 log abundance and 066 complements. Unformalized.

title: Fundamental groups of special complex varieties and root orbifolds
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Campana's abelianity conjecture: 'special' compact Kähler manifolds have virtually abelian fundamental groups. Also proves 2-step nilpotent linear monodromy for special quasi-projective varieties.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Extraordinary claim, unformalized. Uses 033 orbifold subadditivity.

title: Semialgebraic universal covers and bounded domains
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the Kollár–Pardon conjecture: universal covers of projective varieties that are semialgebraic are exactly products of a bounded symmetric domain, C^m and a simply connected projective variety.
opportunity: None.
caveats: The bounded-domain half is Lean-formalized. The main theorem uses 034 log abundance and 057.

title: Counterexamples to Zariski’s multiplicity conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Constructs pairs of isolated hypersurface singularities that are topologically the same (ambiently homeomorphic) but have different multiplicities (2 vs 3; 4 vs 5 in C^4), disproving Zariski's multiplicity conjecture.
constructive: partial: explicit families with sufficiently large parameters
opportunity: None. CAS/resolution was checked. Resolution algorithms (Villamayor, Bierstone–Milman; Singular resolve.lib) use multiplicity as an algebraic invariant and never assume it is topological. Nothing changes.
caveats: Semi-explicit germs ('for sufficiently large a,b'). Unformalized.

title: The Global Spherical Shell conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the Global Spherical Shell conjecture: every minimal class VII surface with b_2 > 0 contains a global spherical shell, which essentially classifies these surfaces as Kato surfaces.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Extraordinary, single manuscript, unformalized.

title: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture: positive quaternionic-Kähler manifolds are symmetric (Wolf spaces). It also classifies projective contact manifolds.
opportunity: None. PHYS was checked: N=2 supergravity hypermultiplet targets are negative-curvature quaternionic-Kähler (Bagger–Witten), so classifying positive QK manifolds does not restrict them.
caveats: Extraordinary (decades-old conjecture), unformalized.

title: The generalized Mukai conjecture
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the generalized Mukai conjecture bounding the Picard number of Fano manifolds by dimension and pseudoindex: ρ(ι−1) ≤ n.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Unformalized.

title: Topological triviality of μ-constant surface singularities
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves that a 1-parameter family of isolated surface singularities in C^3 with constant Milnor number is topologically trivial. This settles the last open case of the Lê–Ramanujam μ-constant problem.
opportunity: None. CAS was checked. μ is computable (Singular sing.lib 'milnor'), so μ-constancy is now a computable certificate of topological triviality for surface families in C^3. But no applied workflow needs it; catastrophe-theory uses (optics caustics) involve simple/unimodal quasi-homogeneous families, where triviality was already known.
caveats: Long-standing problem, unformalized.

title: Virasoro constraints for complete intersections and projective-bundle towers
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the Virasoro constraints, symmetries of the generating function of Gromov–Witten curve counts, for all smooth complete intersections in projective space and for projective bundles over bases that satisfy them.
opportunity: None. Mirror symmetry/topological strings (PHYS) was checked. For CY3 complete intersections such as the quintic, Virasoro was already known (Getzler 1999), and higher-genus GV computations use holomorphic anomaly plus gap/Castelnuovo boundary conditions, not Virasoro. For Fano and general-type complete intersections, descendant GW computation is a pure-math activity.
caveats: Unformalized.

title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Shokurov's bounded klt complements conjecture (finite rational coefficients): Fano-type contractions have klt complements of index bounded by dimension and ε.
opportunity: None. Bounds are existential.
caveats: Lean covers only a supporting compactness lemma. Depends on the generalized-lc minimal models of 036, which use 034.

title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves Campana–Peternell in dimension 6: Fano sixfolds with nef tangent bundle are rational homogeneous spaces.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Unformalized.

title: Anticanonical nonvanishing in every dimension
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves that if the anticanonical bundle of a smooth projective variety has a smooth semipositive metric, some power has a nonzero section (anticanonical nonvanishing).
opportunity: None.
caveats: Unformalized; 7-manuscript chain.

title: Global quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level
subject: Algebraic and complex geometry
plain_english: Proves the quantum geometric Langlands equivalence at irrational level for all simple groups and curves.
opportunity: None.
caveats: Unformalized; builds on the 2024 Gaitsgory et al. proof of geometric Langlands.
